_about: Mage Skills Expansion: balance and registration of the new skills. Edit numbers here, then rebuild:
uuid      - skill name from the exe table (0x89D560). Stage 2a: a free name (Chain Hit 0x0E / Newt 0x39);
the game stores the skill under this name's number (hotbar, save).
name      - shown name (English) and the localisation key.
code_path - existing skill class that runs the skill (exe has no data-driven behaviour).
ranks     - mana = EnduranceCost, cooldown = seconds, level = hero level for the rank, params = ParamN of the class
(Magic Missile: Param1 = missiles per cast, Param2 = damage per missile; [N] in the text = ParamN).
Fireball, from its own description: Param3 = magic damage, Param5 = radius in metres, Param10 = % chance
to set on fire; Param1/2/4/6/7/8/9/11 not known - kept as in Fireball (Param11 = 0 as in its rank 16).
Div2Fix [MageSkills] gives the hero the skill (Grant = exe ids) and shows its own icon (skillbutton_<uuid>_*).
All numbers are EXPERIMENTAL until checked in game (docs/BALANCE.md).
